about: The collecta of the formulary “Fourth Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who are afflicted by the desert of our deeds may be refreshed by the consolation of Thy grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
